data.one_liner: Library for calculating Islamic prayer times in Dart
data.what_it_does: Provides high‑precision astronomical calculations for prayer times, supporting multiple calculation methods and time zones. It exposes a simple API to get today’s or custom date prayer times.
use_when: You need accurate prayer times for a Flutter or Dart app
You want to support multiple calculation methods and custom adjustments
You prefer a dependency‑free, lightweight library
avoid_when: You need a UI widget set for prayer times
You require network or storage features beyond calculation
strengths: No external dependencies, low method overhead
Supports many calculation methods and custom adjustments
weaknesses: Limited to prayer time calculations only
data.setup_notes: Add dependency to pubspec and import 'package:adhan/adhan.dart'; no special permissions needed
